purpose: Create one minimal source-distinct but behavior-compatible accepted-main successor so the canonical Release Set Build can naturally publish the second immutable Release Set v2 required by the FC-6 live staging rehearsal.

required_preconditions: predecessor Release Set v2 A is directly and durably observed
A is proven to come from the canonical accepted-main Release Set Build
all protected required contexts are green
guarded merge is bound to the exact candidate head

invariants: This document is evidence intent only and never becomes release, lifecycle, promotion, or production authority.
Merge is forbidden until the original predecessor Release Set v2 A from accepted main is directly and durably observed.
The successor must enter protected main only through the normal PR, exact-head CI, branch-protection, and guarded-merge path.
Release Set v2 B must be created only by the ordinary accepted-main Release Set Build workflow after merge.
Rollback must reuse the original durable A bytes; A must never be rebuilt or repackaged for FC-6.
Production remains blocked and AR-12 remains not started throughout FC-6 and FC-7.
